question: Who among the following was the first Indian female musician to win the Grammy award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tanvi Shah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tanvi Shah is the first female **from India to win a Grammy award.
 
• She hails from **Tamil Nadu** and was born on 1 December 1985.
 
• She has sung in **Telugu, Tamil, Hindi, Spanish, Portuguese, and Arabic**.
 
• She shared the Gr**ammy Award for Best Song written for visual media with AR Rehman and Gulzar at the 52nd Grammy Awards for the song Jai Ho** for writing Spanish lyrics for the song.
 
• Other awards won by her are the **BMI award in 2009**, **World Sound Track Award in 2009**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Grammy Award is an award presented by the US Recording Academy to recognize outstanding achievements in the music industry of the United States.
 
• On **May 4, 1959, the very first Grammy Award** ceremony was held to respect and honour the musical accomplishments of performers for the year 1958.
 
• The **first Indian** to receive a Grammy Award was** Ravi Shankar** in **1968 **for 'West Meets East in the category of Best Chamber Music Performance
